prompt: Investigate the sudden increase in checkout latency using the repository and available local diagnostics. Propose the smallest safe mitigation, implement it only after review, and verify that observability remains intact.

ordinaryCodex.adaptiveInterior: Codex decides which code, configuration, tests, and local diagnostic artifacts to inspect.
ordinaryCodex.observableAfterRun: Thread items, tool activity, changes, and the final response.

phases.name: Collect evidence read-only
phases.goal: Reproduce or characterize the latency increase from local evidence, separating observations from hypotheses and making no mutation.

phases.name: Rank causal hypotheses
phases.goal: Compare plausible causes, identify disconfirming evidence, and propose the smallest reversible mitigation.

phases.name: Authorize mitigation
phases.question: Approve this mitigation scope and its rollback trigger before any repository change?

phases.name: Apply minimal mitigation
phases.goal: Implement only the approved mitigation and preserve or improve the relevant instrumentation.

phases.name: Verify latency and signals
phases.criteria: The local reproduction improves or is resolved, focused regressions pass, instrumentation still reports the relevant signals, and rollback remains possible.

limits: This is a repository-local incident workflow, not authority to mutate production systems.
This illustrative program has not been executed or scored.
Codex still chooses its internal diagnostic and edit actions inside each Work phase.
